resources.string: Forwards your bank transaction SMS to Darakav, where you confirm them into your accounts. One-time passwords and personal messages never leave this phone.
In Darakav, open Bank SMS → Phones → Connect a phone, choose this app and create a key. Then scan the QR code, or paste the setup code below.
Scan the QR code shown in Darakav
This is not a Darakav setup code. Create a new phone key in Darakav and try again.
This phone is already connected. Use the new key instead? Messages not yet sent are discarded.
This connection is not encrypted (http). Use it only for testing on your own network.
Darakav does not accept this phone\'s key any more. Connect the phone again.
Darakav could not be reached. Messages wait on the phone and are sent when it is back.
Import bank SMS from the last 60 days
Importing needs permission to read your SMS.
%1$d bank messages queued. Darakav skips ones it already has.
New bank SMS will no longer be sent to Darakav. Also remove the phone in Darakav → Bank SMS → Phones.
Stopped: the key was removed in Darakav. Connect the phone again.
Only messages that look like bank transactions are sent, over the connection shown above. The key is stored only in this app and is not included in backups.
